key_insight: CareConnect is a safety-first LLM agent that automates healthcare scheduling and facility logistics while refusing medical advice or diagnosis.
clinical_relevance: It could reduce administrative burden and improve appointment access, but it is designed for operational support rather than clinical decision-making.
method: Used LLM function calling plus retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).
Applied layered deterministic safety guardrails and short-circuit refusal for emergencies or medical intent.
Orchestrated eight domain-specific tools for booking, changing, canceling, and retrieving facility information.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on 680 task-oriented scenarios, achieving 91.8% task completion, 96.0% safety compliance, 2.2-second median latency, and $0.0324 average cost per appointment.
watch_item: Real-world deployment still depends on robust integration with legacy systems and careful handling of edge cases, safety failures, and emergency detection.
paper_title: Toward Trustworthy Large Language Model Agents in Healthcare
